briefing_title_en: Daily Briefing, Nov. 3: AI Self-Improvement Warning, US-Iran Tensions and Market Pullback
briefing_summary_en: This eight-section briefing focuses on Anthropic’s warning about recursive self-improvement, agent-harness and world-model research, plus Codex and LifeVal tools. Developer coverage includes uv.lock troubleshooting, Vercel flag connections and LLM CLI updates. Science highlights trans-Neptunian objects, Perseverance’s driving record, IceCube neutrinos and medical studies. Startups feature Readwise Books and Agent Inbox. World news covers US-Iran tensions before the midterms, Ukraine and trade strains. China covers 15th Five-Year Plan marine and IP measures, the Wuzhen summit and a Lijian-2 launch. Finance tracks tech selloffs, China’s market-support tools and an expected BOE hike. Opinion discusses AI-era mathematics, an Ubuntu patch delay and Anthropic’s IPO.
